primary_metric: Mean average precision across clean, 10%, 30%, and 50% MCAR test conditions
limitations: Three synthetic-data seeds only; exploratory pilot, not evidence of statistical significance or external validity.
The primary preregistered improvement threshold was +0.005 mean AP; observed improvement was +0.003434.
Uniform corruption severity matched or exceeded Beta(2,1) on held-out aggregate AP, so the proposed severity schedule was not supported.
The DFCN primary study already uses joint classification and masked-input reconstruction regularization under random masking; this proposal is not novel as a mechanism.
Candidate training times were recorded; HGB training and inference timings were not instrumented in this run.

The experiment script's final mode writes fixed artifact paths and does not require an explicit overwrite flag; preserve the frozen results.json and do not rerun final without an explicit copy/overwrite policy.
